name: codebase-classification
title_zh: 改代码前先给代码库分个类再动手
tagline_zh: 拿到陌生仓库别急着改，先判断它是单体、微服务还是遗留系统。避免用错套路，把简单改动做成大工程。
tagline_en: Before you edit an unfamiliar repo, classify it first. Avoid applying the wrong playbook and turning a small.
desc_en: Classify codebases before modification to choose appropriate development approach
why_zh: 它把架构识别变成显式步骤，逼你在动手前先回答『这是什么』，而不是凭感觉直接改。
why_en: It turns architecture recognition into an explicit step, forcing you to answer 'what is this' before touching code, instead of.
limit_zh: 只做分类，不产出修改方案。需要你已有基本的架构常识（如知道单体与微服务的区别），否则分类结果对你没指导意义。
limit_en: Classifies only, no fix suggestions. Requires basic architecture knowledge (e.g., monolith vs microservices) to be useful.
